name: Nakamura Eiji
source: He's the hero of this story. He happened to become a father while he was leading a vagabond life in Europe. Even after becoming a father, he still flatters girls, following his philosophy, "Always be kind to women." He returns to his country and starts working at the nursing school. Of course, student nurses won't leave this good-looking father alone!
